scenarios.prompt: A CNC milling process targets a hole diameter of 10.0mm with USL = 10.5mm, LSL = 9.5mm. Sample data shows mean = 10.18mm, sd = 0.12mm. Compute Cp and Cpk. Note: the process is off-center, so Cp and Cpk will differ — do not report them as equal.

A component has only an upper specification limit: USL = 200 (impurity ppm, must not exceed). There is no lower limit. Process mean = 178, sd = 8. Compute Cpk. Note: with only USL, Cpk = Cpu = (USL - mean) / (3*sd). Do NOT use the two-sided formula.
USL = 10, LSL = 5, mean = 7.5, sd = 0 (process is perfectly deterministic in this sample). Compute Cpk.
